Epic close verdict. All 9 children are closed; the last, 596b-919d-8d2a-404a, merged as 73e90b296e2 (Gerrit 3173). Every criterion was re-run against that landed tree rather than inherited from the child closes.

AC1 PASS. src/rebar/_engine_support/resolver.py no longer exists. The only surviving mentions are three lines in docs/archive/tier-e-execution-plan.md, an archived historical plan, not importers. All 7 reducer/_processors.py re-exports are gone: _rederive_keyring_keys, process_key_event, process_signature, _fold_claimed_session, _fold_close_metadata, _fold_plan_review_phase, process_status each have zero occurrences in the module, and 're-exported for back-compat' has zero hits across src. Modules that still import attestation_kind from _processors are not relying on a shim: _processors imports it for its own use at :499 and the name is defined in _processors_identity.

AC2 PASS. git grep for _LEGACY_ENV_ALIASES and _map_legacy_env over src scripts docs returns nothing. The two remaining hits repo-wide are inside tests/fixtures/cloud_adf_corpus/bodies_00.json and tests/fixtures/dc_wiki_corpus/table.json, frozen reconciler corpora that quote a historical ticket comment as text.

AC3 PASS. An AST pass over src/rebar/_deprecations.py counts exactly 6 _tomb calls, every one class 'error', every one carrying a real removed_in: five at v0.8.0 (TICKETS_TRACKER_DIR, REBAR_MCP_ALLOW_RECONCILE_LIVE, verify.require_verdict_for_close, .rebar/config.conf, REBAR_LLM_MAX_ITERS) and one at v0.12.0 (REBAR_LLM_MODEL). No warn-class row survives.

AC4 PASS, checked as parity rather than in isolation. A scratch project carrying an unknown key under [llm] and a second carrying one under the non-reserved [verify] behave identically: one warning line each under the default policy, and under REBAR_CONFIG_UNKNOWN_KEYS=error a real command (rebar show) exits 1 for both. rebar config validate stays exit 0 for both sections, so [llm] is now governed by the same policy as any other section rather than being silently skipped as reserved. tests/unit/test_config_llm_known_keys.py 5 passed.

AC5 PASS. git grep for REBAR_HLC_NOW and REBAR_TEST_COMPACT_RENAME_BARRIER over src returns nothing; both now reach child processes through the test-owned hook in tests/_child_hooks.py.

AC6 PASS. git grep for HEARTBEAT_SOURCE and github-api over src scripts .github tests returns nothing. The workflow dispatch input, the environment variable, and check-heartbeat --source are all gone; the canary reads canonical bridge status unconditionally, and _check_github_heartbeat survives only as the NEVER_RUN bootstrap witness ADR 0094 requires.

Closing-tree evidence: make verify green at 73e90b296e2 with 20117 passed, 27 skipped, exit 0.

No force override was used anywhere in this epic.
